#!/bin/bash

function find_value_for_key {
    local alist=("$@")
    local key=${alist[-1]}
    local value=""
    local pair

    for pair in "${alist[@]::${#alist[@]}-1}"; do
        IFS=',' read -r k v <<< "$pair"
        if [[ $k == $key ]]; then
            value=$v
            break
        fi
    done

    echo "$value"
}
